hook: The middle class works harder than ever and still feels stuck. Rising costs are real, but inside most budgets there is money leaking into things that don't make life better. In this video I go through 20 things the middle class wastes money on, from three angles: the big-ticket numbers, the social pressure behind the spending, and the boring leaks like taxes and insurance that are the easiest money you'll ever find.
tags: things the middle class wastes money on
